courses.overview: 從「道格灘離岸風電場」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Dogger Bank offshore wind farm into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 高壓直流換流站
related.why: 把「道格灘離岸風電場」與「高壓直流換流站」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Dogger Bank offshore wind farm with HVDC converter stations: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: Hitachi Energy 全球總部代表點
place.coordinateScope: 公開機構／城市的近似代表座標，非設備或可進入的施工位置；總部不表示本課所有製程在該處進行。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public institutional/city coordinates, not equipment or accessible worksites; headquarters does not imply all processes occur there.

related.transfer: 大型海上風電需要集電、海纜與岸上電網協調，直流輸電是跨越海陸介面的系統方案之一。
related.transferEn: Large offshore wind projects coordinate collection networks, subsea cables and the onshore grid; HVDC is one system solution across that boundary.
related.difference: 風機出力隨風況變化；換流站負責電能轉換和控制，不能把風機銘牌容量當成每時刻輸出。
related.differenceEn: Turbine output varies with wind; converters transform and control electrical power, so nameplate capacity is not continuous delivered output.
practice: 連接風機、海上站與岸上站
指出電壓轉換和交直流轉換位置
用兩種風況比較傳輸功率需求
practiceEn: Connect turbines, offshore station and onshore station
Locate voltage conversion and AC/DC conversion
Compare transmission demand under two wind conditions

related.title: 伊泰普水電站
related.why: 把「道格灘離岸風電場」與「伊泰普水電站」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Dogger Bank offshore wind farm with Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: 伊泰普大壩（代表定位點）
place.city: 伊瓜蘇市／埃爾南達里亞斯
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 大型再生能源都把自然能量轉成機械和電力，再透過電網介面交付。
related.transferEn: Large renewable-energy projects convert natural energy into mechanical and electrical energy before grid delivery.
related.difference: 伊泰普以可調度水流驅動水輪機；離岸風電受風況影響，儲能條件、機組配置和維護環境不同。
related.differenceEn: Itaipu uses controlled water flow through turbines; offshore wind varies with wind conditions, with different storage context, machine layouts and maintenance environments.
practice: 畫出水輪與風輪的能量鏈
比較可控輸入與天候輸入
列出容量之外應記錄的運行資料
practiceEn: Draw hydro and wind energy chains
List operating data needed beyond nameplate capacity

courses.summary: Dogger Bank 為北海離岸風電分期工程，結合大型風機、海纜與 HVDC 外送。地圖選泰恩港陸上運維基地，用以說明海上工程如何依靠港口、人員與監控系統；它不是風機所在地。課程只引用已公布的里程碑，不把規劃容量寫成已全數投運。
courses.summaryEn: Dogger Bank is a phased North Sea offshore project combining large turbines, cables and HVDC export. The map marks its onshore Port of Tyne operations base to explain port, workforce and monitoring support; it is not a turbine location. Published milestones do not imply full commissioned capacity.
courses.connection: 與大型變壓器及伊泰普課程比較電網介面、設備可靠度與生命週期；海上氣候窗口與風能變動則是此案特有的重要條件。
courses.connectionEn: Compare grid interfaces, reliability and lifecycle with transformers and Itaipu; marine weather windows and variable wind resources are important differences.

roles.role: Dogger Bank 合資方並負責營運階段。

roles.businessEn: Norwegian energy company operating North Sea fields, Sleipner CO2 storage and Hywind floating wind.

roles.businessEn: Supplies gas, hydro and wind power equipment, grid systems and GE Hitachi nuclear technology.

courses.connection: 從「道格灘離岸風電場」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
